approvers: My tax adviser, my bank, the notary, my staff and my family
reason: This is my life's work and nine people depend on me. A company with no earlier sellers and no track record is a lot to ask me to trust, and I keep putting this kind of decision off. I would listen over a coffee, but I will not sign quickly.
objection: Why would my bank, tax adviser and notary accept a buyer like this? Nobody has sold to them before, and I do not know what really happens to my people once I let go.
instead: Keep running the shop myself, and maybe look for a buyer through my tax adviser or nexxt-change, or ask a trusted employee or a local competitor.
would_change_my_mind: My own tax adviser and bank vouching for them after checking, and meeting the directors in person at my site and hearing them speak to my staff.
